description: This Java class `GenericEngineFactory` is responsible for creating and managing instances of `GenericEngine`. It retrieves engine class names from configuration, dynamically loads classes, and ensures singleton-like behavior for each engine instance within the factory. The class provides a method to access a specific engine by name, handling class loading and instantiation via reflection, with thread-safe caching.

classes.name: GenericEngineFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and caching instances of `GenericEngine` based on engine names. It retrieves class names from configuration, loads classes dynamically, and ensures thread-safe instantiation.

methods.name: GenericEngineFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with a `ServiceDispatcher` instance and setting up the engines map.

methods.name: getGenericEngine
methods.description: Retrieves a `GenericEngine` instance corresponding to the provided engine name, loading and instantiating the class via reflection if necessary.
